builds.howItPlays: You dig in at a battlefield with cheap blockers and answers, using spells like Rebuke and Gust to send back or stun whatever your opponent commits there. Every turn you hold that spot you exhaust Vex to draw an extra card, so your hand keeps filling with answers while your opponent runs out of good plays.
builds.whyYou: You like sitting back, watching what your opponent does, and having the right answer ready when they commit to something. You don't mind losing the early turns as long as you end up drawing more cards than the other player and grinding them down over time. If patience and a strong finish feel better to you than a fast win, Vex fits you well.
builds.ratingNotes: pace 2: riftboundguide.com calls it 'a slow, patient game' built on attrition, weak to aggressive decks that don't give it time to set up. stance 1.5: riftbound.gg describes it as reactive, built to 'get set on a location and control whatever unit the opponent might develop to contest it'; riftboundguide.com says 'your opponent plays a unit, and you have an answer.' complexity 7: riftboundguide.com says players must 'recognise when to hold and when to push, and that takes a few games to develop,' calling it 'a strong second or third deck rather than a first purchase.' variance 3: riftboundguide.com calls it 'relatively low variance' with a consistent grinding plan rather than explosive swings. Legend ability: exhaust Vex to draw a card whenever you or an ally holds a battlefield. Confidence: high, two dedicated guides agree closely on the deck's identity. Reviewer should double-check: starterDeck was corrected from the seed's generic 'Unleashed Champion Deck' to the Riot Store listing 'Unleashed Champion Deck: Vex'.
